summary: Q1 2026 earnings beat: revenue $111.7B vs $109.6B consensus (+2% YoY), adjusted EPS $6.90. Guidance raised with $2B+ share buyback announced. Prior authorization reduced 30% by end 2026. New institutional position taken (Indivisible Partners). Stock up ~17% post-Q1 earnings. RSI approaching buy territory as stock edges slightly lower this week.
